Lechonk

Normal

Paldea · Generation 9

Lechonk is a Normal-type Hog Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 10.2 kg. It evolves into Oinkologne. Its highest base stat is HP (54), with a base stat total of 254.
